QA-79142 passed 3/3. The report is at `results/2026-10-26/QA-79142-report.md`.

I ran it for Monday on account HBO Max and brand HBO Max, with the Public data set, Content Type Video, and the default week of Oct 18–24. In each case Sum Engagements divided by Sum Video Views matched the Average Video Response Rate, so I didn't need the second formula.

| Channel | Sum Engagements ÷ Sum Video Views | Average Video Response Rate | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Facebook | 1,447,347 ÷ 20,302,006 = 7.129% | 7.13% | PASS |
| Twitter | 3,065 ÷ 154,227 = 1.987% | 1.99% | PASS |
| TikTok | 1,060,950 ÷ 46,411,992 = 2.286% | 2.29% | PASS |

- **Scope:** I ran only the first Monday account/brand pair (HBO Max); Amazon Prime Video and Conde Nast/Vogue-US were not run.
- **Cross-check:** I checked the Sum row against the per-post rows for Twitter and TikTok only; Facebook's Sum row was read directly.
- **Bugs:** None open or linked. Nothing was filed.
- **Skills/registry:** I made no skill or registry edits, as instructed.
- **Credentials:** I briefly wrote the login credentials to a temporary file inside `.playwright-out/` to load them into the browser session, then deleted it.
